df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='xz8lX1K'].copy()

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='xz8lX1K'].copy()
piv = a.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','instance_family'], columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
for d in ['2025-10-13','2025-10-14','2025-10-27','2025-10-28']:
    prevd = (pd.Timestamp(d)-pd.Timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    diff = (piv[d]-piv[prevd]).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print(d, [x for x in diff.head(3).items()])"}

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='xz8lX1K'].copy()
# check for any price changes on other days too (besides 10/20)
piv = a.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','instance_family','application'], columns='date', values='price', aggfunc='max')
ch = piv[piv.diff(axis=1).fillna(0).abs().sum(axis=1)>0]
for idx,row in ch.iterrows():
    print(idx, row[row!=row.shift().dropna().reindex(row.index).fillna(row)].to_dict() if False else '')
print(ch.T.ffill().T.to_string())"}
